title: Proof-of-Concept weekly ops log and decision register
body:
Purpose
- Capture week-by-week operational plan for the customer POC (RetailAssist AI).
- Maintain a running task tracker + decisions register + quick workshop notes for on-call and SE handoff.

Context and objectives
- Customer: RetailAssist (mid-market e-commerce). Primary ask: 2-week demo showing 5k QPS embeddings for semantic search + safe generation for product QA assistant.
- Success criteria (customer-facing):
  - Query latency 95th <= 200ms for text-embedding-requests under demo load (simulated 5k QPS).
  - End-to-end search correctness on 10 golden queries >= 0.78 MRR compared to baseline.
  - No PII leakage in generated answers (automated eval pass).

High-level approach
1) Provision dedicated small pool (2x A40 equiv) in dedicated cluster for demo traffic spike.
2) Use quantized local variant of open-embedding model + caching layer for cold-start prefixes.
3) Instrument Redwood Console dashboards: per-route latency, token cost, cache hit rate.
4) Run workshop with customer on Day 3 to align prompts and acceptance tests.

POC timeline (week-by-week)
Week 0 - Prep (pre-engagement, internal)
- Confirm dataset access + NDA signed (owner: Samira).
- Baseline runbook: perf test harness + synthetic corpus generator (owner: Miguel).
- Risk check: customer firewall + VPC peering windows (SRE).

Week 1 - Core deploy + basic validation
- Day 1: private tenant provisioning, model artifacts uploaded (owner: Jonah).
- Day 2: inference runtime config: batching 32/100ms, prefix cache enabled (owner: Aisha).
- Day 3: smoke tests (latency under 500ms), internal demo.
- Day 4: instrument cost and token accounting, run 1k QPS smoke.
- Day 5: workshop with customer (2hr) — collect prompts, failure cases, acceptance corpus.

Week 2 - Load testing and UAT
- Day 1-2: scale perf tests to 5k QPS with traffic replay. Capture p95/p99.
- Day 3: iterate on kernel selection and quantization profile if p95 > target.
- Day 4: run safety scans, generate adversarial prompts from customer workshop.
- Day 5: customer UAT and sign-off on demo readiness.

Post-demo week - Wrap and handoff
- Consolidate logs, cost projection, and recommended dedicated sizing for production.
- Produce handoff doc for CSM and infra teams.

Operational task tracker (live)
Format: [task id] | task | owner | ETA | status | notes
- [T-101] Provision demo tenant | Jonah Ruiz | 2024-11-12 | done | VPN + KMS stub configured
- [T-102] Upload model artifacts | Jonah Ruiz | 2024-11-13 | done | also added quantized variant v1-q8
- [T-103] Configure batching & cache | Aisha Chen | 2024-11-14 | in_progress | batching 32/100ms, need to validate sequence-length distro
- [T-104] Perf harness (5k QPS) | Miguel Torres | 2024-11-15 | in_progress | synthetic corpus ready, replay script failing at high concurrency
- [T-105] Workshop prep doc | Samira Patel | 2024-11-15 | done | agenda + customer acceptance list attached
- [T-106] Safety regression checks | Aisha Chen | 2024-11-18 | todo | run modified tox suite + adversarial prompts
- [T-107] Cost projection spreadsheet | Finance contact: Priyanka | 2024-11-20 | todo | rough numbers using live token rates

Open questions / unknowns (for SE + SRE)
- Customer will likely enable cross-region failover — need to confirm peering timelines (unknown: precise CIDR allow list).
- Can we use ephemeral cache snapshot for demo? Bandwidth limit from their VPC unclear.
- Acceptance metric threshold: customer might accept p95 250ms for interactive demo instead of 200ms — confirm during workshop.

Risk register (top-3)
- R1: Network e2e (VPC / firewall) delay > mitigations: schedule early peering test, provide local fallback using hosted endpoint for demo.
- R2: Model size causing OOM at batch 32 mitigations: fallback to dynamic batching 16/200ms, enable kv-cache eviction policy.
- R3: Safety false positives blocking demo mitigations: isolated safety config for demo with monitoring and escape hatch to reduce hallucination constraints for non-sensitive queries.

Decisions register (living)
- D-01 (2024-11-07): Use dedicated private deployment for demo to guarantee isolation. Decided by: Aisha + Jonah. Rationale: customer required no-sandbox environment for catalogue data.
- D-02 (2024-11-10): Default to quantized model v1-q8 for embeddings. Decided by: Miguel. Rationale: reduces memory footprint enabling targeted throughput.
- D-03 (2024-11-13): Batch size 32 with 100ms latency cap for initial test. Decided by: SE team. Rationale: tradeoff between utilization and latency; revisit after perf run.

Workshop notes (customer call — 2024-11-15)
- Attendees: RetailAssist (product lead: Elena P.), Redwood: Aisha, Miguel, Samira, Jonah.
- Elena: high priority on not surfacing internal SKUs in generated text — asked about PII scanning and redaction.
- Action: add targeted regex filters and run generated answer scanner on workshop transcripts (owner: Aisha).
- Workshop exercise: we reviewed 12 golden queries — 3 flagged for ambiguous intent, agreed to add clarifying follow-ups in prompt layer.

Immediate actions after workshop
- Aisha: run safety/adversarial suite and submit results (ETA 2 business days).
- Miguel: fix perf harness concurrency bug and rerun 5k QPS (ETA 3 business days).
- Jonah: validate KMS access and rotate demo key to customer-provided KMS if requested (ETA 5 business days).

Handoff checklist for demo day
- Infra: tenant + KV cache warmed, autoscaling policy set (owner: SRE).
- SE: acceptance tests uploaded to CI and smoke script scheduled.
- CSM: customer invites + demo runbook (2hr) with fallback notes.

Appendix: quick notes and shorthand (scratchpad)
- latency anomalies at p99 look correlated to long sequences (512+). Need test w/ truncated input.
- consider moving embedding index build to offline step to reduce demo-day CPU spikes.
- runbook link: CONFL-1538 (see linked artifacts).

Status log (patch notes)
- 2024-11-06: initial draft of plan (Aisha).
- 2024-11-12: tenant provisioned, models uploaded (Jonah).
- 2024-11-15: customer workshop completed; acceptance corpus added (Samira).
- 2024-11-18: safety suite queued (Aisha).

Notes to self
- Keep the decision register minimal and timestamped. If customer escalates, escalate D-01 to execs.
